Broad dark blue-grey rectangular metal panel across the lower middle, thin vertical pale worn rib lines at exactly the source positions, very narrow brown metallic inset along the far right. Upper band contains a dark horizontal rectangular strip. Keep all grey padding and cut edges. No new ribs or holes. Original logical size 64x64, target 256x256; maintain the 64:64 canvas aspect and direct proportional layout.
